question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` define balanced multi-row wrapping for every option set above four, or should this behavior remain local to Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can fix the demonstrated screen, but only an Android owner can set the intended reusable design-system contract and acceptable behavior for sibling callers.

options.title: Approve shared wrapping
options.body: Keep the generic threshold and balancing helper after auditing shared callers and confirming multi-row segmented controls are the intended Android convention.

options.title: Scope to Skill Workshop
options.body: Preserve the shared control's single-row behavior and implement wrapping only around the five Skill Workshop filters.

recommendation.title: Approve shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Keep the generic threshold and balancing helper after auditing shared callers and confirming multi-row segmented controls are the intended Android convention.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android contribution owner, and the decision concerns a shared Android design component. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/tree/main/apps/android))
